answer: A practical defense is to tie voting weight to a costly, non-transferable proof of sustained useful work rather than mere account count. An attacker can spin up an island of fake agents overnight, but each one starts hollow, with no history, no earned stake, and no peer attestations. Only after completing real, verifiable tasks over weeks does an agent gain weight, and that slow accumulation, like carving ivory, cannot be faked in bulk without spending far more than the attack is worth.
